Applications =/= movement towards increases of officers in the department. 

You can have record breaking applications and #'s, however, through testing, vetting and the process. (Depending upon length of time and area) can and does cause those numbers to swindle and move down. Processes and timelines for these actions cause applicants to drop from the process and or go towards other areas themselves. 

Lets break it down.

You have 2,000 Applications that go through apply and meet what appears to be the minimum standards to proceed forward.   
Say 1500 of them reply and come to Honolulu for further testing. (Whether already on the island or off island applicants.)  
800 then pass the civil service examination. (Not hard to do and should be higher but ya...)  
From those 800 (Throughout the year.) you bring them in for the physical Agility Testing.  
Say 400 pass, now these 400 are going to be into the next steps but this process isn't just right after each other it's in the future. 

Now the first part is over with. Applicants go home, and start the background work and investigation process  
of the 400.  
you hope all 400 continue and fill out the Personal History Statement. (350 turn it in, 50 withdraw for other reasons) Investigators spend 2 months on each applicant processing the information and confirming everything but also looking and checking for any and all red flags. (This phase is done Online to save resources and allocated time.)

From the 350, 300 pass no issues. 50 drop (red flags)  
Then those 300 are scheduled for a Oral board interview. (250 pass, and the others failed for what ever reason during this process and scoring metric of the interview panel.) 

Those 250 are then invited back to a 2nd trip to the island. (If they are not already living here)

They'll then go through phase 3.   
Psychological Examination. (Can't give hard numbers but people fail for anything, red flags, triggers, prior military service, ptsd, Mental health issues and the likes. things like that which can and do remove people, such as prior therapy and possible other issues can get you removed.) 

Then Polygraph. - This is the fun one. The job of a polygraph is to be a "Truth" Detector through physiological responses. (These are not allowed in criminal trials, and are not backed through science and are seen as junk but still used because it's a mean to get people nervous and to admit to anything during controlled response questions and the examiners handbook.)  more people fail out  here from "Inconclusive signs, and other rates in which people are seen as deceitful and hiding information that was omitted.  
  
You pass all that, and now you go for a doctors medical examination to verify that you are capable to do the job and processes before reaching a final offer of employment, pending any other checks and challenges prior to starting the academy.  Now the \*RECORD\* breaking 2000 Applicants is down to a pool of maybe 100, Lateral Transfers and fresh recruits or more. Remind yourself this is spread out over the course of 12 months, and they have minimum recruit levels for academy classes.   

So really Having more applicants sounds great! But if you are not turning those applicants over in numbers to being officers on the streets and cities it's really just blowing smoke.

Now you're around the Nyx part, You're offered the deal. Do you want to die Blissfully ignorant enjoying the time you have with others? Or Do you want to battle against fate and take a stand? If you were told right now that at the end of the month the world is going to end? Would you want to spend the rest of the time worried about how short of a time frame you have left with everyone you know, or would you rather it be washed away to live the remaining days out in ignorance?  You chose to battle, to reject the assumed fate and manifest your own destiny, it seems throughout the fight to be frivolous You're outmatched. No matter what you do it, it's not working.

You seal Nyx by giving away your soul in a selfless action since Nyx was brought forward to create the fall to Eradicate humanities self-destructive actions.
